description: Implement the full in-meeting chat feature using Chime SDK DataMessage API, with markdown rendering, hyperlink handling, and emoji reactions. This includes: a useChat hook, a ChatPanel component with message rendering, a ChatMessage component with markdown/link support, emoji reaction support on messages, and integration into the meeting UI with a toggle button.
steps: Create src/hooks/useChat.ts - A custom hook that: (1) uses useAudioVideo() to access the AudioVideoFacade, (2) subscribes to 'chat-message' and 'chat-reaction' DataMessage topics via realtimeSubscribeToReceiveDataMessage(), (3) provides sendMessage(text: string) using realtimeSendDataMessage('chat-message', ...) with JSON payload {senderName, message, messageId, timestamp}, (4) provides sendReaction(messageId: string, emoji: string) using realtimeSendDataMessage('chat-reaction', ...) with JSON payload {messageId, emoji, senderName}, (5) maintains messages state array with type ChatMessage {id, senderName, text, timestamp, reactions: Map<string, string[]>}, (6) cleans up subscriptions on unmount. Use the attendee name from the Chime roster (useRosterState) or generate one using generateAttendeeName(). DataMessage lifetime should be set to 300000ms (5 minutes) so late joiners get recent messages.

Create src/components/ChatMessage.tsx - A component that renders a single chat message: (1) shows sender name and timestamp, (2) renders message content using ReactMarkdown with remark-gfm plugin for markdown support (headings, bold, italic, lists, code blocks, tables), (3) automatically makes URLs clickable via markdown link syntax and remark-gfm autolink literals, (4) shows emoji reaction buttons below the message, (5) has an 'add reaction' button that shows a small picker with common emojis (thumbs up, heart, laugh, surprised, sad, fire, clap, 100). Reactions show the emoji plus count and list of who reacted on hover/title attribute.

Create src/components/ChatPanel.tsx - A panel component that: (1) displays the list of ChatMessages with auto-scroll to bottom on new messages, (2) has a text input at the bottom with send button (and Enter key to send), (3) shows a placeholder when no messages exist, (4) uses @aws-amplify/ui-react components for styling (View, Card, Text, Button, TextField, Flex, ScrollView, Badge). Style it as a side panel that can slide in/out.

Create src/components/ChatToggleButton.tsx - A control bar button for the MeetingControlBar that toggles the chat panel visibility. Show an unread message count badge when chat is closed and new messages arrive.

Create a ChatContext (src/context/ChatContext.tsx) using React Context to share chat state (messages, sendMessage, sendReaction, unreadCount, isChatOpen, toggleChat) between the ChatToggleButton in the control bar and the ChatPanel in the main meeting view.

Integrate the chat into App.tsx: (1) Wrap the meeting area with ChatProvider, (2) Add ChatPanel next to the VideoMeeting component (side-by-side layout when open), (3) Add the ChatToggleButton to MeetingControlBar.tsx.

Update vite.config.ts to exclude new chat components from coverage thresholds (src/components/ChatPanel.tsx, src/components/ChatMessage.tsx, src/components/ChatToggleButton.tsx) to match existing pattern of excluding complex UI components.
acceptance_criteria: useChat hook correctly sends and receives DataMessages via the Chime SDK AudioVideoFacade
Chat messages render with full markdown support (bold, italic, code, lists, links)
URLs in messages are automatically rendered as clickable hyperlinks
Users can add emoji reactions to any message
Reactions show emoji, count, and who reacted
Chat panel toggles open/closed from the control bar
Unread badge shows count when panel is closed and new messages arrive
Late joiners receive recent message history (DataMessage lifetime of 5 minutes)
TypeScript compilation passes with no errors
verification: Run 'npx tsc -b' and confirm no type errors
Run 'npx vite build' and confirm production build succeeds
Run 'npx vitest run' and confirm all existing tests still pass
findings: The AudioVideoFacade's realtimeUnsubscribeFromReceiveDataMessage only accepts a single argument (topic string), not a callback. The useChat hook was adjusted accordingly. The ChatProvider wraps only the meeting content area (when joinedMeetingId is truthy) so it has access to the AudioVideoFacade. MeetingControlBar is rendered inside ChatProvider. VideoMeeting width changed from fixed 80vw to 100% to flex properly alongside the ChatPanel.
